newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia c.bank sells HRK271 mln bills, same rates.
newsitem.headline: Croatia c.bank sells HRK271 mln bills, same rates.

text.p: Croatia's central bank said on Thursday it had sold 271 million kuna worth of 35- and 91-day liquidity bills at an auction on Tuesday.
Volume rose from only tens of millions recently as banks with excess funds which bid for the bills experienced a pre-Christmas liquidity squeeze.
But the rates were stuck at 8.0 and 9.5 percent for 35- and 91-day paper respectively, although money market rates for comparable length interbank loans rose before the holidays to over 15 percent.
The next weekly bill tender is on January 8.
